Correction of data caused by user error beyond minor cases
New features, redesigns and new integrations (change requests)
reporting: Monthly support report: tickets by severity, SLA achievement, effort used against the monthly pool

Run L1 support for end users and log tickets with steps, screenshots and business impact
Keep HBLAB's access to production, the Azure subscription and third-party portals (payment gateway, CRM, ...) valid
Notify event Sundays and planned changes in third-party systems at least 10 working days in advance
Arrange and pay for the annual VAPT and share the report with HBLAB
Test and approve fixes on staging within 3 working days so releases are not delayed
